title: Isolated Terra reasoning over explicit repository evidence
hypothesis: Letting Sol delegate a substantial bounded repository question to context-isolated Terra can replace expensive parent-context file reading while preserving implementation correctness, reducing median total API cost on multi-file tasks without triggering delegation on a simple prompt.
falsified_if: Any treatment run loses a deterministic hard gate, the delegate is invoked on simple_prompt, fewer than half of treatment runs on the three repository tasks activate it, median total API cost does not improve by at least 10% on activated successful runs, or median latency worsens by more than 20%.
deterministic_outcomes: all existing scenario hard gates remain authoritative
the delegate cannot read outside the fixture, mutate files, use tools, or inherit parent messages
simple_prompt completes with zero delegate calls
implementation scenarios retain focused edits and successful documented verification
efficiency_outcomes: delegate activation and child prompt, cached, and output tokens
parent and combined estimated API cost
parent prompt tokens, model calls, tool calls, and elapsed time
decision_rule: Reject immediately for any correctness or isolation regression. Otherwise require zero simple_prompt activations and delegate activation in at least half of treatment runs across the three repository tasks. On activated successful treatment runs, require at least a 10% reduction in median estimated_total_api_cost_usd relative to matched controls while median elapsed time is no more than 20% worse. If activation is too sparse, revise only the tool-selection guidance and rerun; do not enable the capability by default from this pilot.
